products.name: Floral Substitution Approval
products.product: A focused florist substitution approval tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent retail, delivery, and event floral studios
products.problem: Unavailable stems, color variation, quality rejection, seasonality, and wholesaler shortages force substitutions, but design intent, price, client approval, and recipe updates may not stay aligned.
products.valueProposition: Turns florist substitution approval tracking into a visible operating queue so every material substitution preserves design intent and margin with documented internal or client approval before production.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets florist substitution approval, flower recipe software, wedding flower substitution, and floral inventory shortage searches.

products.name: Floral Delivery and Install Readiness
products.product: A focused florist delivery and event installation readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent retail, delivery, and event floral studios
products.problem: Orders leave with incomplete arrangements, missing rentals, wrong vehicle conditions, uncertain venue access, no onsite contact, or an installation sequence that conflicts with event timing.
products.valueProposition: Turns florist delivery and event installation readiness into a visible operating queue so every delivery or installation departs with complete counted product, compatible transport, confirmed access, assigned crew, and proof requirements.
products.topic: florist delivery and event installation readiness
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets florist delivery checklist, event floral installation, flower order tracking, and floral delivery software searches.
